_doc: S&P 500 + curated extensions — the curated screener universe (superseded sp100.json on 2026-05-30). Every ticker here is seeded as `auto_analysis` and pre-analyzed nightly; any other ticker is researchable on demand (`analyzed_on_demand`) and stays off the screener. This file is a static, hand-reviewed snapshot: nothing modifies it automatically. Check drift with `python -m app.scripts.universe_review [--compare-feed]` or `GET /api/admin/universe-review`; pull the live FMP constituent list with `python -m app.scripts.refresh_universe_lists` (explicit operator action, requires FMP Premium).
_dual_class_policy: When a company has multiple share classes in the index (Alphabet GOOG/GOOGL, Berkshire BRK.A/BRK.B), we list only one ticker per company. Picked GOOGL (Class A, voting) and BRK.B (lower-priced, more retail-tradeable) as the canonical tickers.
_starter_note: This is a 170-ticker starter list (SP100 + 63 strategic extensions: foreign-listed ADRs + sub-industry semis + high-conviction large caps), NOT the full SP500. Run `python -m app.scripts.refresh_universe_lists` with FMP Premium to populate the remaining ~340 names. Until then, screener + comps work over this subset; lazy `analyzed_on_demand` loading covers any ticker the user researches directly.
_review_source: manual review of the shipped starter list; live FMP constituent pull remains an explicit operator action
